name: Gonka
short: Decentralized inference network with OpenAI-compatible access to open models (DeepSeek, GLM, MiniMax, BGE, etc.). New keys start with 100K free tokens; the recurring 1M-tokens/month free tier needs either a minimum $10 top-up or phone verification (one number per account).

plans.name: Free tier
plans.notes: At least 1M free tokens every month (floor = 1M tokens of the most expensive catalog model; cheaper models yield more, e.g. ~1.2M on DeepSeek V4 Flash / GLM-5.3-Flash). Recurring - resets on the 1st of each month; free tokens are spent before paid balance. OpenAI-compatible endpoint (https://proxy.gonkabroker.com/v1). A brand-new key starts with only 100K free tokens; the recurring 1M-tokens/month free tier is kept by either a minimum $10 wallet top-up or phone verification (one phone number per account).
plans._readonly: [READ-ONLY · operator first-hand at app.gonkabroker.com/api-keys, 2026-11-05 · do not delete] The recurring 1M-tokens/month free tier is gated behind EITHER a minimum $10 wallet top-up OR phone verification (one phone number per account); a brand-new key starts with only 100K free tokens — so it is not truly 'no credit card'. This field is NOT rendered on the website (routes/providers shows only name/price/notes/evidenceUrl). Never delete/shorten/soften this; only the operator may change it.
